subtitle_en: then continued toward White Pass by pack horse.

subtitle_zh: 的重要补水点。
subtitle_en: for steam locomotives climbing the grade.

subtitle_zh: 铁路工人也曾在这里驻守，
subtitle_en: Railway workers also stayed here

subtitle_en: to maintain this mountain line.

subtitle_en: At Slippery Rock,

subtitle_en: with Glacier Gorge directly below.

subtitle_en: Early workers drilled and blasted into dangerous rock faces
notes: Mile 15.6: Slippery Rock - 2139FT; single location; segment 4/5; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 开出这条路基。
subtitle_en: to carve out this roadbed.

subtitle_zh: 铁路以隧道、桥梁和急弯
subtitle_en: where tunnels, bridges, and sharp curves

subtitle_en: overcame the rugged White Pass terrain.

subtitle_en: This is one of the classic mountain views

subtitle_en: on the White Pass journey.

subtitle_en: which is why it was also called the Dead Horse Trail.

subtitle_en: It was once one of the most representative landmarks

subtitle_en: and improving modern operating safety.
